name: ON_SIDE_ROAD_ARROW_WHITE_LONG
notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Sheet 'c' is the white edge and 'd' the edge + border (read as AS 1743 does: 10/30 = edge 10 + border 20, 5/15 = 5 + 10, 15/45 = 15 + 30), confirmed against the national R-series pairs. Q-series sheet R9-Q05 'On side road' supplementary plate for black-on-white traffic instruction signs (2000/2023), the white version of the national W8-3. Size A 600 x 400 generated (B 750 x 500, C 900 x 600, D 1200 x 800 also tabled), r 25, c 5 / d 15. Chain n 56 / m 80D ON / k 35 / h 80C SIDE ROAD / g 25 / f 80 (arrow) / e 44 = 400: cap tops 56 and 171, arrow 276-356. SIDE ROAD gap not stated: 46 measured from the sheet's drawing. Arrow 'per AS 1743 W8-3' (sheet note 3): the W8-3 polygon (400 x 100 at the 750 sign) scaled 0.8 to 320 x 80, centred; drawn (L) pointing left, (R) mirrored. Black on white.
